Finance IndustryIndustry Overview
Google map marking the location of micro finance operators
•The microfinance industry in Lao PDR currently consists of more than 
90 licensed operators , the majority of which are small - to mid -sized 
players with limited capital, fragmented operating models, and minimal 
brand presence. As a result, no institution has yet emerged as a true 
market leader in terms of loan portfolio size, nationwide coverage, or 
brand dominance. 
With no established national leader and strong parallels to Thailand where 
the Top 3 players now control 65% of the market —Lao PDR presents a 
unique first -mover opportunity.
Backed by strong capital, a lower cost of funds, and institutional -grade risk 
management, we are strategically positioned to become market leader in 
this growing sector.The Lao microfinance industry is at an inflection point.
